purpose: Single declarative entry point for the custom Viv tokenizer/transformer identity-layer training lifecycle. This file links the governed engine, supervisor, governor, contracts, preflight, lineage, output policy, and reversible organization rules.

active_engine.reason: The active engine, supervisor, governor, trainer, focused tests, and custom tokenizer/transformer sources now resolve from the canonical Training/Viv-SLM package. Historical foundation/scripts and foundation/lib entry paths remain thin compatibility shims; moved historical VSLM sources are retained under Training/legacy/viv_slm.

future_output_policy.rule: Future Viv-SLM canary outputs are to be declared under the canonical Training root. Existing V1-V59 model paths remain immutable historical references until a path-migration contract rewrites every consumer and passes preflight.

contents: viv_slm/ active engine, trainer, model, governor, supervisor, data builder, and focused tests
compatibility shims remain outside this root only for historical callers
references to the existing legacy training archive
checkpoint lineage indexes and future canonical copies
receipts, probes, manifests, journals, backups, negative evidence indexes

existing_aifl_compatibility.rule: Do not relocate this registered AIFL code during the Viv-SLM migration without a separate registry and import rewrite.

existing_runs.rule: New Viv-SLM runs use the viv_slm subroot; existing runs remain in place until reference classification is complete.

standard_workflow: Verify all authority flags are closed before preparation or evaluation.
Create a declarative contract with parent and input hashes.
Run engine and supervisor dry-runs with side effects false.
Run focused tests and full foundation preflight.
Create an exact-scope authorization backup only when the canary is approved.
Run exactly one bounded 250-step increment through the supervisor.
Close training and run authority immediately after return, before interpreting outputs.
Evaluate metrics and independent semantic, V15, conversation, telemetry, and CPU-contract probes.
Retain improvements and negative evidence in the ledger and task record; promote only through separate authority.
v60_gate: Do not authorize the V60 canary until the migration plan reaches IMPORTS_AND_PATHS_VERIFIED, the identity-first V60 data package is hash verified, the scoped Git backup is pushed, the V60 contract dry-runs pass, and full preflight passes with authority closed.
